decisions: Core default Off (every pinned hash and the probe hash keep their values); the game turns it On in GameSession.RoundConfig. The attract round and the probe DemoScenario stay Off.
BorderRideFactor and BorderRideDelay are SimConfig fields with literal defaults, not Tuning constants (SimConfig_DefaultsMirrorEveryTuningConstant counts Tuning constants).

Contact = the R4 step was constrained (slide or hold) or the step ends within 0.02 u of the inset line. Contact start = exact instant the straight path reaches that tolerance (bisection), so it does not depend on the tick rate.

The ride starts at contact start + delay inside the tick (normal motion before, ride after). A held head (pushing within the hold angle) rides too; direction = side the desired heading leans to, +OutwardNormal.Perp() when straight in (|component| < 1e-9).

New input = desired heading more than 20 degrees from the one the ride last accepted (joystick wobble tolerance). A new input pointing inward by more than BorderHoldAngle from the tangent ends the ride; a new input along the border the other way reverses it.

Auto-follow: sub-steps of at most 0.05 u. Classic square: tangent step projected back onto the convex inset rounded box. Polygon: tangent of the active edge that pushes least into the other active edges (turns at convex vertices instead of being held), arc of radius margin around reflex vertices; result always inside the inset shape. Less than 20 % progress in a tick (dead end) ends the ride.

La Revanche: no ride and no contact time while chased. A spark that appears mid-tick ends the ride from the next tick (the rest of the cut tick, at most 1/TickRate s, was already planned at ride speed: changing a tick's target mid event loop would break the precomputed visit lists). Spark speed unchanged. SparkCatchEta and the bot escape math stay exact for chased players because they never ride.
Within a tick the motion stays the straight segment from start to target: a corner rounded in one tick is drawn as its chord.
Feedback: TraitFxView streak only; no sound (a new SimEventType would break the event count test and touch more shared files).

written: BorderRide_CrossRate_SameOutcomesAndSameRideInstantAt30_60_144Hz (outcomes and ride instant across rates, StateHash determinism within one rate as per contract 10.0 item 3)
